tips.text: Take Death Marks from Hyena Pack on Psamathe or The Sergeant on Iliad; both are short missions.
Keep your only Despair blueprint until it is built; players who sold one waited years for another.
Stay marked through your normal Sedna or Hydron missions instead of hunting him on purpose.
Stack marks from different bosses and use one per mission; several marks in one mission do not raise the odds.
Join low-rank squads; they are constantly marked, so you meet Stalker more often.
Use Volt with Shocking Speed, Gauss or Titania to burn through The Sergeant.
Use a Stalker Beacon in a short mission, since it is consumed on use.
Expect wildly different luck: some get it from their first few Stalkers, others have dozens of his other drops and no Despair.
